posts.name: cajunjoel
posts.cooked:
Okay, it looks like I need better monitoring than "server alive".

One of the servers that runs the site was down(-ish) and not responding to web requests, but was still receiving traffic and if you hit the bad machine (50/50 chance) you got stuck there. It should all be back to normal now. I'm going to keep an eye on things the rest of today and enable more and better monitoring. 

Thanks for your patience. I didn't initially see anything wrong, but I also didn't look as deeply as I could. The intermittent nature of these things is also misleading sometimes. It took a warning of a failed backup to make me look deeper.

--J
